intro:
Changing your password is required to protect your personal information.
It has been 6 months since your last change. If you choose “Change later”, you'll be reminded in 6 months.
hint: 8–20 characters with letters, numbers and symbols.
formatError: Min. 8 characters (8–20 with letters, numbers, symbols)

submitError.containsPersonalInfo: Passwords containing personal info are not allowed.
submitError.passwordsDiffer: New and confirm passwords must match.
submitError.sameAsOriginal: New password can't be the same as the old one.
submitError.fallback: An error occurred. Contact the administrator.

done.title: Password changed
done.message:
Your password has been changed.
For account security, previously logged-in devices were logged out.
Please log in again.
